symptom: pi extension silently inert: auto-discovery error 'Require stack: ~/.pi/agent/extensions/x.ts' because a .mjs symlink breaks the adapter's relative imports
cause: pi's auto-discovery accepts only .ts/.js, and jiti resolves relative imports against the link path, not the real target
fix: install writes a generated re-export shim (export { default } from '<abs adapter path>') instead of a symlink
